newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both the dollar and pound on Wednesday after a central bank intervention on Tuesday, commercial forex dealers said.
The rupee traded at a mean commercial rate of 19.873 against the dollar from 19.888 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the rupee was fixed at a mean rate of 33.7025 from 33.7125 on Tuesday.

Forex dealers said the central bank sold $900,000 during a market intervention on Tuesday mid-morning at a rate five cents lower than the prevailing interbank market rate, resulting in a firmer rupee on Wednesday.
"The central bank intervened when commercial banks were long (in hard currency reserves). That's why the market intervention involved a relatively low amount of dollar sale," a dealer said.
